ev.q: Set within the fictional American city of Lost Heaven during the 1930s
Mafias storyline gameplay consists of driving, mainly easy city cruises between different locations
51 cars around the city can be driven in Mafia
the rest of the game is based on third-person on-foot navigation and shooting
critics praising the game for its complex narrative and realism
as more realistic and serious than a usual Grand Theft Auto-styled game
Mafia contains a much bigger city to explore than most video games of the time
